verificationMethod: Independent source re-read with at least 30 surrounding lines for each finding, all relevant event/effect/render paths, and in-memory execution of unchanged CaseList/TUE handler source with deferred API stubs.

findings.reason: clearFilters only updates filters. No filter-dependent effect calls loadCases; the sole initialization effect has []. The clear button is outside the form, so no implicit submit repairs the missing reload. Pending debounce is not cancelled.
findings.attemptedCounterevidence: Checked form boundary, onClick wiring, all useEffect/loadCases/debouncedSearch call sites and debounce implementation. None trigger a fresh query on this state change.
findings.reproduction: Executed the actual clearFilters source against counters in memory: empty filters assigned, loadCalls=0, debounceCancelCalls=0.
findings.recommendation: Cancel queued debounce, invalidate prior requests, set empty filters and request page1 explicitly.

findings.reason: All request completions update state unconditionally; neither the Axios client nor the component supplies cancellation or request identity. Cache hit does not invalidate prior requests. Initialization can also submit empty filters after a user's request.
findings.attemptedCounterevidence: Checked shared API client/interceptors, cache behavior, initialization, debounce cancellation and callbacks. Debounce prevents only requests not yet sent.
findings.reproduction: Executed unchanged loadCases source with deferred A and B; resolved B then A. Final cases=['A'] despite latest submitted query B.
findings.recommendation: Use a request sequence or AbortController, guard all data/error/loading updates, and avoid initialization overwriting a user query.

findings.reason: The only setError call sets the failure string. Neither request start, success nor cache hit clears it; error banner renders independently of a successful cases list.
findings.attemptedCounterevidence: Searched all setError call sites and checked error render branch. No component reset occurs during same-page retry.
findings.reproduction: Executed actual loadCases source: rejected first request then successfully resolved another. Cases=['good'] while error remains '載入案例資料失敗，請稍後再試。'.
findings.recommendation: Clear errors for a new/latest successful request; stale failures must not overwrite current status.

findings.reason: On initial navigation, caseData is null. Any Axios rejection is swallowed by catch and loading becomes false; the only ensuing null branch displays '案例不存在'. HTTP404, HTTP500 and network failure have no separate state.
findings.attemptedCounterevidence: Checked route element/keying and global ErrorBoundary. The local catch consumes the failure, so the global boundary cannot render an alternative error.
findings.reproduction: Source-control-flow proof: initial null + rejected getById + finally false necessarily reaches the nonexistence branch. Browser/network injection remains pending.
findings.recommendation: Distinguish404 from load errors and provide retry. ID-change stale response handling can be fixed with the same request cleanup but is not counted as a separately browser-verified defect.

findings.reason: The button is disabled while loading, but input Enter invokes handleDrugCheck without a guard. The handler and finally unconditionally update state. Editing the input also leaves the preceding result visible.
findings.attemptedCounterevidence: The getSubstances effect has an active guard, but it applies only to the independent dropdown request. The quick-check handler has none. Checked button/input conditions and result render.
findings.reproduction: Executed actual handleDrugCheck source with deferred A and B; resolved B then A. Final result.drugName='A' after B was the latest submitted query.
findings.scopeCorrection: The result card explicitly shows displayName||drugName at line1479. Keep the finding as old result overwrites latest result / input and result diverge; do not claim the card hides which drug produced the answer.
findings.recommendation: Unify keyboard/button submission, guard request identity, and bind/clear result when editing the query.

findings.reason: ADRV rejection only logs; adrv stays null. Main loading is already false and the violationTypes panel uses !adrv as a permanent spinner condition. Tab changes do not retry ADRV.
findings.attemptedCounterevidence: The shared educational error state is set only by getAll failure; it is not used by ADRV catch. The second activeTab effect loads caseLearning cases only.
findings.reproduction: Source-control-flow proof: getAll succeeds, getAdrv rejects, activeTab='violationTypes' results in !adrv spinner with no retry/error branch. Browser injection remains pending.
findings.recommendation: Give ADRV independent loading/error state and an actionable retry path.

findings.reason: ArrowDown opens menu and effect focuses a Link. Escape sets open=false, unmounting that focused Link; the trigger has no ref and no code restores focus.
findings.attemptedCounterevidence: Reviewed outer ref, menuRef, entire key handler, focus effect, trigger and Link handlers. No blur/Escape focus-return branch exists.
findings.scopeCorrection: Missing focus restoration is source-confirmed. The exact next-Tab destination varies with browser behavior and was not measured; remove any assertion of a specifically reproduced cross-browser Tab order.
findings.reproduction: Browser keyboard reproduction pending; source clearly lacks return-to-trigger on Escape.
findings.recommendation: Add a trigger ref and restore focus on Escape; verify keyboard behavior in the intended browser.

findings.reason: Three selects have adjacent labels but no id/htmlFor, wrapper label, aria-label or aria-labelledby. Competition buttons change only CSS classes and expose no aria-pressed/radio checked state.
findings.attemptedCounterevidence: Checked entire surrounding JSX and all label/name attributes. The quick drug text input does have aria-label, but it is a different control. The decision result role=status does not name the selects or expose button selection.
findings.reproduction: Complete JSX attribute inspection confirms absent programmatic label/selection association; accessibility-tree check remains pending.
findings.qualification: Native selects may announce their selected option value; this does not provide the missing field name. No claim that all screen readers are completely silent.
findings.recommendation: Connect stable select IDs to labels and use a labelled native radio group or explicit pressed state for competition context.

limitations: This verifies the source state read during the audit, before the parent applies fixes.
No browser screenshots, accessibility tree, production HTTP calls or layout measurements were collected.
No medical/regulatory content accuracy claims were added.
Only this JSON and the previously authorized pass1-api.json were written.
